title: Elon Musk and Donald Trump: What their growing ties mean for Ukraine
summary: The recent disruption of SpaceX’s Starlink satellite internet service in Ukraine comes as Washington steps up pressure on Kyiv to halt its strikes on Russian oil refineries.
